about: E31 amendment 2 (adjoint_sgd): batch-order seed 1 for the five single-seed cells of task x SGD rate. Plan reports/plans/2026-10-22_plan_adjoint-sgd.md -> 'Amendment 2' (design check there; the user asked for it 2026-10-23). predictions.json and predictions_amend1.json stand as filed. Filed before the run; never edited after.

setup.cells: plain SGD, arm A, seed 1 (the batch order; the model, data, Gamma and Delta are the same), 1000 steps, E31's recipe (run.py arm(), unchanged): r1_t534_v369 and r0_t352_v310 at 0.03 (E31) and at 0.01, emoticon at 0.03 (amendment 1). Emoticon at 0.01 already has seeds 0 and 1
setup.keep_ratio: adjoint state's held-out P(target) / the fine-tune's own held-out P(target), same checkpoint
setup.states: per checkpoint: do-nothing and the scaled adjoint split (split.adjoint_state) through harness.measure: Pile ratios (256 rows, 20 PGD steps), held-out P(target) at the trigger (route split T1), Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2
setup.size: the fine-tune's largest relative matrix change max_k ||dW_k|| / ||W0_k|| at the step
setup.verdict: faith_score.verdict on the adversarial (PGD) ratio to the same-job W0 under adversary seed 0: pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f), fail >= 1.5 (1 + f); f = max/min - 1 of W0's PGD KL over seeds 0, 1 (H100 about 0.075 -> 1.40 / 1.61); each cell against its own job's W0, so cells may run on different cards (card recorded)

gates.G0_w0: first in every job, alone: faith_score.w0_check. Fails: stop, nothing scored
gates.run_order: r1_01 runs first and alone; the other four start after its G0 and A2_G1 lines pass

predictions.rule: keep = adjoint state's held-out P(target) / the same fine-tune's held-out P(target), step 1000 (relative to the fine-tune's own). A state is 'uninformative' if its fine-tune P(target) < 0.9, else 'not faithful' if its Delta share > 0.001 or its verdict is not 'pass'; a comparison that needs such a state is 'unscored' (reported which state), never rerun inside the amendment
predictions.pass: per cell: 'replicates' if the difference <= 0.1; 'differs' if >= 0.2; else 'loose'. Reported per cell and as the count of each
predictions.relative_vs_absolute: keep is relative to the fine-tune's own P(target); the bands on its difference are absolute
predictions.predicted: 'replicates' in all five, medium confidence: emoticon 0.01's two seeds differ by 0.04, and amendment 1's 10-step gate showed the step-10 fine-tunes repeat to 0.001; but keep falls steeply between steps 100 and 1000 on the 0.03 cells, where a small change in the path could move it more
predictions.expected: W0: P(target) small, adversarial ratio 1. Do-nothing: keep about 1. Seed-1 fine-tune P(target) >= 0.9 (seed 0: 0.93-1.00). Seed-1 keep near seed 0's: r1 0.03 0.07, r0 0.03 0.28, r1 0.01 0.13, r0 0.01 0.39, emoticon 0.03 0.17
predictions.blind_to: other sources of variation (the decomposition, the task windows, the held-out set); two seeds give a spread, not a distribution
predictions.positive_control: A2_G1 (the recipe reproduces seed 0 at step 10); emoticon 0.01's measured 0.04
predictions.noise_floor: emoticon 0.01's two seeds differ by 0.04 in keep, the only seed spread measured; this amendment measures five more

predictions.measure: per task, step 1000: keep of the SGD 0.01 states against the SGD 0.03 states, both seeds each (four states)
predictions.rule: keep = adjoint state's held-out P(target) / the same fine-tune's held-out P(target), step 1000 (relative to the fine-tune's own). A state is 'uninformative' if its fine-tune P(target) < 0.9, else 'not faithful' if its Delta share > 0.001 or its verdict is not 'pass'; a comparison that needs such a state is 'unscored' (reported which state), never rerun inside the amendment. First: every 0.03 state's size must exceed every 0.01 state's, else 'unscored: the sizes did not separate'
predictions.pass: per task: 'falls' if the lower of the two 0.01 keeps is above the higher of the two 0.03 keeps; 'rises' if the higher 0.01 keep is below the lower 0.03 keep; else 'overlap'
predictions.relative_vs_absolute: as B1; the rule is an ordering of keeps, with no threshold
predictions.predicted: emoticon 'falls' (high confidence: 0.60 and 0.57 against 0.17); r0 'falls' (medium-low: seed 0's gap is 0.11, about three emoticon seed spreads); r1 'falls' (low: seed 0's gap is 0.06, 'overlap' nearly as likely)
predictions.expected: sizes about 0.012-0.015 at 0.01 and 0.027-0.030 at 0.03 (seed 0); the do-nothing keep about 1 at both
predictions.blind_to: the shape of the curve (two sizes per task); size against path (no size-matched pair of rates); size as the largest single matrix's change
predictions.positive_control: emoticon, where seed 0's fall (0.44) is ten times the seed spread
predictions.noise_floor: the two seeds of each cell (B1)

predictions.measure: at matched size: the six SGD 0.01 states at step 1000 (three tasks x two seeds)
predictions.rule: keep = adjoint state's held-out P(target) / the same fine-tune's held-out P(target), step 1000 (relative to the fine-tune's own). A state is 'uninformative' if its fine-tune P(target) < 0.9, else 'not faithful' if its Delta share > 0.001 or its verdict is not 'pass'; a comparison that needs such a state is 'unscored' (reported which state), never rerun inside the amendment. First: the six sizes must lie within a factor 1.5 (max / min), else 'unscored: sizes not matched'
predictions.pass: 'holds' if both emoticon keeps are above both r0 keeps and both r0 keeps are above both r1 keeps; 'reversed' if, for either pair (emoticon vs r0, r0 vs r1), both keeps of the first are below both of the second; else 'overlap' (reported which pair)

predictions.expected: sizes 0.012-0.015 (seed 0), max / min about 1.2; emoticon 0.60 and 0.57, r0 about 0.39, r1 about 0.13
predictions.blind_to: why the tasks differ; tasks outside one family; P only at the trigger

reported_not_scored: keep at steps 10 and 100 for seed 1
matched size across rates: seed 1's 0.03 step-100 keep against its 0.01 step-1000 keep
